en: Bucharest, 25 April 1953. A rented room, a round table, one candle and a receipt.
The medium closes her eyes. The candle flame leans toward the ceiling. Candles are not supposed to do that.
The candle goes out. One thousand eight hundred and fifty-two years earlier, you open your eyes in Sarmizegetusa.
Click or Enter: next.   Esc: skip the séance.
Later. A forest. Probably the same day.
The saucer comes down east of the river. You come down with it, slightly more gently.
Communication of 5 May 1953. They have returned you. Lighter by half a sack of food, which they took as a sample. Every probe needs a control group.
Communication of 6 May 1953. Dumped in a forest again. The saucer will circle back. Saucers always circle back. It is the only shape they know.

Communication of 7 May 1953. You have crashed a saucer. Do you know what those cost? Neither do I, we never paid. Still, I will note that the surgeon's notes are now yours. Read them. Mind the drawings.
Communication of 12 June 1953. The priests of Zalmoxis found you in a ditch and charged a third of your purse for the stretcher. Healthcare, year 101: still not free.
Communication of 13 June 1953. Back at the temple. The priests have started keeping a bed with your name on it. They did not ask your name. It just says 'that one'.
Communication of 14 June 1953. The temple again. You are not dead, which in my professional opinion is the most suspicious thing about you.
